sentence_stem: It is very dark in the room,
full_sentence: It is very dark in the room, turn on the light.

options.why_wrong: Closing the window does not make the room lighter, so it does not solve the problem of darkness.
This is a polite imperative, but it does not answer the problem of darkness.
Turning off the light would make the room even darker, so it is the opposite of what is needed.

grammar_focus: Imperative sentences (base form of the verb, no subject)
explanation: An imperative gives an instruction and uses the base form of the verb with no subject. Ukrainian speakers may add a subject such as 'you' by habit, because Ukrainian imperatives have their own verb endings and learners often expect a similar structure in English.
translation: В кімнаті дуже темно, тому увімкніть світло.
